rationale: The original short thesis remains fully intact: the broader market regime has deteriorated further (SPY down 1.82%, VIXY up 11.82%), while COIN continues to trade near the bottom of its range (20.8%) below both declining session VWAP ($140.49) and the 5-minute 9-EMA ($139.64). The recent 1-minute bounce from $138.62 to $139.31 occurred on very light volume (~17k-24k shares per bar) compared to the preceding sell candle (72k shares), indicating a weak technical pullback rather than a reversal. Holding for the $136.89 session-low target remains the highest-expectancy play with invalidation well-protected above VWAP at $141.30.
